StockPortfolioTracker.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the object with an empty portfolio and sets the cash balance from the provided input value." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> cash_balance </REF>: any "Initial cash balance to assign to the object."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize the portfolio field to an empty list. RESULT self.portfolio]
            [COMMAND Assign the provided cash_balance value directly to the cash_balance field. RESULT self.cash_balance]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
StockPortfolioTracker.add_stock:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Updates the quantity of an existing portfolio item with the same stock name, or appends the stock if no match is found." add_stock]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The object containing the portfolio list."
        <REF> stock </REF>: dict "The stock item to add, including name and quantity."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Iterate through each portfolio item in self.portfolio. RESULT pf]
            [COMMAND Within the loop, if the current item name matches stock['name'], add stock['quantity'] to that item's quantity and return immediately. RESULT updated_item]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: No portfolio item has a name equal to stock['name'] after the loop completes.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append the stock object to self.portfolio. RESULT self.portfolio]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
StockPortfolioTracker.remove_stock:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Remove a matching stock holding from the portfolio by reducing its quantity, deleting it if the quantity reaches zero, and returning whether the update succeeded." remove_stock]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> stock </REF>: dict "Stock record containing at least name and quantity fields to remove from the portfolio."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "True if a matching portfolio holding with sufficient quantity was found and updated; otherwise False."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Iterate through each portfolio item in self.portfolio. RESULT pf]
            [COMMAND For each portfolio item, check whether pf['name'] matches stock['name'] and pf['quantity'] is greater than or equal to stock['quantity']. RESULT match_found]
            [COMMAND If a match is found, subtract stock['quantity'] from pf['quantity']. RESULT updated_quantity]
            [COMMAND Within the matching item path, if the updated quantity is exactly 0, remove that portfolio item from self.portfolio. RESULT portfolio_updated]
            [COMMAND After the first successful match and update, return True immediately. RESULT true]
            [COMMAND If no portfolio item satisfies the match and quantity requirements, return False after the loop completes. RESULT false]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
StockPortfolioTracker.buy_stock:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Buys stock only when its total cost does not exceed the available cash balance, otherwise rejects the purchase." buy_stock]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> stock </REF>: dict "A stock record containing price and quantity."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "True if the stock was purchased and cash was deducted, otherwise False."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compute the total purchase cost as stock['price'] * stock['quantity']. RESULT cost]
            [COMMAND Compare the total cost against self.cash_balance using a strict greater-than check. RESULT can_afford]
            [COMMAND If the total cost is greater than self.cash_balance, return False immediately. RESULT False]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, add the stock by calling self.add_stock(stock). RESULT self.add_stock(stock)]
            [COMMAND Deduct the same total cost from self.cash_balance. RESULT updated_cash_balance]
            [COMMAND Return True to confirm the purchase succeeded. RESULT True]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The total cost of the stock purchase is strictly greater than the available cash balance.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Reject the purchase without modifying holdings or cash, and return False. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
StockPortfolioTracker.sell_stock:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Attempts to remove the stock first, returns False if removal fails, otherwise adds the sale proceeds to cash balance and returns True." sell_stock]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> stock </REF>: dict "Stock record containing price and quantity used to compute sale proceeds."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "False if stock removal fails; True after cash balance is increased successfully."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether removing the given stock succeeds by calling self.remove_stock(stock). RESULT remove_result]
            [COMMAND If remove_result is False, return False immediately without updating cash balance. RESULT False]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, increase self.cash_balance by stock['price'] multiplied by stock['quantity']. RESULT updated_cash_balance]
            [COMMAND Return True to signal the stock sale completed successfully. RESULT True]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.remove_stock(stock) returns False]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Stop processing immediately and return False. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
StockPortfolioTracker.calculate_portfoli:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes the total portfolio value by adding cash balance to the market value of each stock position." calculate_portfolio_value]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance containing cash balance and a portfolio of stock positions."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: number "Total portfolio value including cash and all stock holdings."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize the running total with the current cash balance. RESULT total_value]
            [COMMAND For each stock in the portfolio, add stock price multiplied by stock quantity to the running total. RESULT total_value]
            [COMMAND Return the final total portfolio value. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
StockPortfolioTracker.get_portfolio_summ:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Builds a list of per-stock name and value entries from the portfolio and returns it together with the total portfolio value." get_portfolio_summary]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance providing portfolio data and stock valuation methods."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: tuple "A tuple containing the total portfolio value and a summary list of stock name/value dictionaries."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty summary list. RESULT summary]
            [COMMAND For each stock in self.portfolio, compute the stock value using self.get_stock_value(stock) and append a dictionary with the stock name and computed value to summary. RESULT summary]
            [COMMAND Compute the total portfolio value using self.calculate_portfolio_value(). RESULT portfolio_value]
            [COMMAND Return the total portfolio value together with the summary list. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
StockPortfolioTracker.get_stock_value:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns the total stock value by multiplying the stock price by the stock quantity." get_stock_value]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance reference."
        <REF> stock </REF>: dict "Dictionary containing at least price and quantity values."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: number "The product of stock['price'] and stock['quantity']."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read stock['price'] from the input stock dictionary. RESULT price]
            [COMMAND Read stock['quantity'] from the input stock dictionary. RESULT quantity]
            [COMMAND Multiply price by quantity to compute the stock value. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Return the computed stock value. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
